concrete_equivalence_check.invented_example_not_a_written22_sign_me: Current destination A; immediately replace the destination by B; record that jar and spoon go to the current destination.
concrete_equivalence_check.reading: Both a retroactive repair of the still-open destination field and a prospective change of the current destination produce the same final jar-to-B and spoon-to-B assertions. Later reuse of B alone cannot distinguish those operations.
concrete_equivalence_check.smallest_unequal_consequence: Write a completed assertion that the jar goes to A before the change, then change the destination to B and write a later spoon assertion. A genuinely retroactive operation targeting that completed assertion changes the jar assertion to B; a prospective update leaves the jar assertion at A. This contrast is available only if the source contract explicitly pays the completion boundary and exact retrospective target. IDEA082 does not yet authorize reaching across an arbitrary completed record.
concrete_equivalence_check.limit: This is a logical source-side contrast, not an assertion that any native form is REPLACE, any native line is a record, or any actual historical entry has this pattern.
